calculation_summary: STAGE 1 - FULL-CONTACT BASELINE. Bracketing query mass (351.24 g) and roughness index (1106.84) using retrieved baselines: creatine (mass 381.0 g, roughness 823.15, force 2.327 N) and 500g_weight (mass 500.0 g, roughness 1129.82, force 1.03 N). Interpolating between these baselines based on proximity yields an estimated full-contact baseline force of approximately 2.15 N. STAGE 2 - WITHIN-SURFACE CONTACT ADJUSTMENT. Query contact fraction is 0.05. Using the controlled variant from creatine where reducing contact by 0.9 increases the force by 1.634 N, we scale this relative contact penalty to account for the very low contact fraction of 0.05. Applying the contact adjustment adds 0.35 N to the baseline. Final estimated normal force = 2.15 N + 0.35 N = 2.50 N.
